title: Robinson spaces and their representation in low-dimensional metric spaces
summary: Robinson spaces are structures equipped with a total order that encodes comparative dissimilarity relationships. We study the problem of representing Robinson dissimilarity spaces into low-dimensional metric spaces. These representations aim to preserve the relative dissimilarity relationships between elements rather than their exact values.
